notes.title: Crafting Town : Release Announcement [28 July 2022]
notes.content:
Hello, I hope you're in a good mood. 

If you ask me, I'm working hard to meet the release date and I'll let you know what's going on in the meantime.

Speaking of release date: 28 July 2022, 14:00 New York Time, my game will be released.

After giving this information, let's come to what innovations I added to the game; 

* There are currently 4 language support, but I plan to add new language options after the game is released. Currently active [English - German - French - Turkish] is available.

* There are currently 24 different achievements active.

* While collecting skins, which was one of the feedbacks from the demo version, the rabbits we hunted were removed from the final version because they were too small.

* The menu screen, which is the entrance to the game, has been completely renewed.

* I did some optimisation work for the places where there was a slight fps drop and now it is more stable.

* After you finish the game, your game save automatically starts you in your village and you can continue playing after the game ends if you wish.

That's all the updates and fixes I can think of right now, I hope my game meets your expectations. If you want to contact me ;

Discord : 
https://discord.gg/8CVh8D7jkE

notes.title: Crafting Town - Feedback Improvements
notes.content:
Hello, long time no see. 

During this time, there was a "Steam Next Fest" event and I had the opportunity to get quite a few feedback. I wanted to share the improvements I made with this feedback.  

Let's start with the feedback section first :

* A detailed tutorial has been added to the game. It now contains a lot of information on how to progress in the game, which areas and how to reach it.

* In addition to increasing the amount with only the arrow keys, which I received many requests, you will now be able to craft and process items by entering numbers.

* The Inventory button and the quests in the collection area are now clearer.

* Reaching your own village is now more convenient and faster.

Let me talk about the parts I just added :

- A neighboring village where you can sell your products at profitable prices.

- A secret area where you can craft Mythic items. Of course, it's not so secret :) .

- An area where you can win ancient trophies and have to make some decisions.

- And three new areas with end game elements.

You can see images of these and more in the screenshots on the "Store Page". 

And I guess that's all I have to say, I'll be making improvements and improvements until my game comes out. Thank you so much for reading this far, if you're interested, you can follow my game and add it to your wishlist. You would help me a lot.

Before I forget, if you want to join discord : 

https://discord.gg/8CVh8D7jkE
